test.create_query: CREATE TABLE mem_prewhere (k UInt64, filt UInt64, s1 String, s2 String, s3 String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory SETTINGS compress = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO mem_prewhere SELECT number, number, randomPrintableASCII(50), randomPrintableASCII(100), randomPrintableASCII(200), rand() FROM numbers_mt(20000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT s1, s2, s3 FROM mem_prewhere WHERE filt BETWEEN 1000000 AND 1000100 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM mem_prewhere WHERE filt = 1000000
SELECT v FROM mem_prewhere PREWHERE filt BETWEEN 1000000 AND 1001000 FORMAT Null
